name: San Francisco County, CA
findings: San Francisco County has 5,398 nonprofit organizations. 2,356 of them (44%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 1,997 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (14% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, San Francisco County has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list civic or political action
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in San Francisco County list civic or political action on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 3.4 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 217 organizations here; 23% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are ways to take civic or political action so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?
